entries.mitigation: Interrupt Melitus immediately when he pins a player; do not let the charged execution complete.
Keep moving during the ground sequence and avoid persistent geysers rather than stacking them under the group.
Move through the maze together enough to interrupt a snared player immediately while the group searches for healing Spriggans.
Watch the root attack and preserve movement lanes instead of letting multiple players get immobilized during the maze phases.
Interrupt Mylenne immediately when she pins a player; burn werewolf adds between pin windows.
Stay out of lightning pools and spread personal lightning strikes so they do not overlap teammates.
Wait for Ernarde to settle on the final symbol, then each player moves to a matching rune before the check resolves.

entries.entry_name: Werewolf Add Waves — Vykosa the Ascendant
entries.mitigation: Stop forcing boss damage when add waves land. Kill dangerous werewolves and stabilize before pushing the next health threshold.
Tank and control wolf pressure away from the group, especially when Hard Mode overlaps release them with other mechanics.
Keep the sisters separated so their colored auras do not augment one another; focus one target at a time.

entries.entry_name: Seasonal Colors — Aghaedh of the Solstice
entries.mitigation: Collect the seasonal color from the small Spriggans and stand in the matching safe circle when Aghaedh channels.

entries.entry_name: Lurcher Adds — Aghaedh of the Solstice
entries.mitigation: Tank and cleave Lurchers promptly so add pressure does not overlap the next seasonal shelter check.
After Dagrund leaps, block or dodge the homing elemental attack. Do not try to simply outrun it.
Prioritize elemental adds before their persistent fire zones and snares accumulate around the group.
Enter stealth for the hunt, spread through the room, preserve stamina, and use the friendly wisp without being detected.
Interrupt immediately. Allowing Lightning Prance to finish can wipe the group.
Move onto a safe island when the water becomes electrified.
Respect poison-plant zones and use the water when required by the spore cycle instead of standing in the contaminated ground.
Keep clear of Fire Remnant pathing during Hard Mode; avoiding it is required for Perfect Hunt.
